_readme: What the OSINT map shows while 'Only my list' is on. Edit this file; the browser sidecar re-reads it on every refresh. Aircraft: an airline is matched by the first letters of the flight's callsign (OpenSky gives callsigns like AFR1234). Ships: AIS says what a vessel is (type, name, destination) but never who owns or charters it, so a company's tankers can only be matched by what you list here: exact names, IMO numbers, MMSI numbers, words in the name, or words in the AIS destination field. A match on a name or a number is firm; a match on the destination is a guess (a tanker bound for Pernis may not be Shell's).

companies.name: Repsol
companies.sources: P. Bel Air and P. Beverly Hills: three-year time charters to Repsol Trading announced by Performance Shipping (may have ended); Sestao Knutsen and Iberica Knutsen: LNG carriers once 50% owned with Repsol (assets later sold to Shell). Verify on Equasis before relying on any of them.

companies.name: Moeve
companies.sources: RS Onza: chemical tanker owned by Suardiaz and working for Moeve (Suardiaz press release). Moeve (formerly Cepsa) has also ordered chemical tankers from RFOcean; add their names here when they are delivered.
